en.title: Orthodontic cases
en.summary: Every orthodontic case still being seen at this branch: who is due back, and whose payments are due to bill or overdue.

sections.heading: The day's list
sections.body: Filter Payments on Due to bill to see whose monthly instalments have fallen due; open each and press Bill what is due. Filter on Overdue for patients to call about a bill. Due back is the last visit plus the weeks it said.

sections.heading: Starting a case
sections.body: Cases are started on the patient's Ortho tab, which holds the appliance, the visits and the payment plan.

am.title: የኦርቶዶንቲክ ኬዞች
am.summary: በዚህ ቅርንጫፍ አሁንም የሚታዩ የኦርቶዶንቲክ ኬዞች፦ ማን መመለስ እንዳለበት፣ የማን ክፍያ መቆረጥ ወይም ያለፈበት እንደሆነ።

sections.heading: የዕለቱ ዝርዝር
sections.body: Payments ን Due to bill ብለው ያጣሩ፤ እያንዳንዱን ከፍተው Bill what is due ይጫኑ። Overdue ለመደወል የሚገባቸውን ታካሚዎች ያሳያል።

sections.heading: ኬዝ መጀመር
sections.body: ኬዞች በታካሚው ኦርቶ ትር ላይ ይጀመራሉ።
